import urllib.request,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET,json,numpy as np,math,sys
from pyproj import Transformer
q=json.loads(sys.argv[1]); IDS={'UP':'1263035782','LOW':'154743324'}
M=np.array([[1.0003134247912262,-0.0019194165053375567,-536557.3209234042],[0.0019307874108104152,1.000363623491413,-8569811.318207301],[0,0,1]],float); tx=Transformer.from_crs(4326,31984,always_xy=True)
d=np.load(r'C:\mcp-blender\.geo-work\terrain_2017_candidate.npz'); pts=d['verts'].reshape(-1,3)
def poly(wid):
 raw=urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request('https://api.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/way/'+wid+'/full',headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}),timeout=30).read(); root=ET.fromstring(raw); nodes={e.attrib['id']:(float(e.attrib['lon']),float(e.attrib['lat'])) for e in root.findall('node')}; w=next(e for e in root.findall('way') if e.attrib.get('id')==wid); ll=[nodes[n.attrib['ref']] for n in w.findall('nd') if n.attrib['ref'] in nodes]; p=np.array([tx.transform(*x) for x in ll]); return (np.column_stack([p,np.ones(len(p))])@M.T)[:,:2]
def inside(p,poly):
 x,y=p; c=False; j=len(poly)-1
 for i in range(len(poly)):
  xi,yi=poly[i]; xj,yj=poly[j]
  if ((yi>y)!=(yj>y)) and x < (xj-xi)*(y-yi)/(yj-yi+1e-30)+xi:c=not c
  j=i
 return c
def closest_seg(p,a,b):
 ab=b-a; t=np.clip(np.dot(p-a,ab)/(np.dot(ab,ab)+1e-30),0,1); z=a+t*ab; return z,float(np.linalg.norm(z-p)),float(t)
def terr(xy):
 dd=(pts[:,0]-xy[0])**2+(pts[:,1]-xy[1])**2; i=int(np.argmin(dd)); return float(pts[i,2]),float(dd[i]**.5),pts[i,:2]
for k,wid in IDS.items():
 P=poly(wid); cur=np.array(q[k],float); tw=np.array(q['TOWER'],float); print(k,'CURRENT',cur.tolist(),'INSIDE',inside(cur,P))
 segs=[]
 for i in range(len(P)-1):
  z,dist,t=closest_seg(cur,P[i],P[i+1]); tz,gd,gxy=terr(z); segs.append((dist,i,z,t,tz,gd,float(np.linalg.norm(z-tw))))
 segs.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
 print(k,'NEAREST_EDGES',[(round(a,3),i,[round(float(v),3) for v in z],round(tz,3),round(r,3)) for a,i,z,t,tz,gd,r in segs[:8]])
 # Find candidate boundary points whose terrain elevation matches urban plateau, prioritized near current door.
 target=60.0 if k=='UP' else 3.5; candidates=[]
 for i in range(len(P)-1):
  a,b=P[i],P[i+1]; L=float(np.linalg.norm(b-a)); n=max(2,int(L/.5)+1)
  for t in np.linspace(0,1,n):
   z=a+t*(b-a); tz,gd,gxy=terr(z); candidates.append((abs(tz-target),float(np.linalg.norm(z-cur)),float(np.linalg.norm(z-tw)),tz,z,i))
 candidates.sort(key=lambda x:(x[0]>1.0,x[1]+3*x[0]))
 print(k,'BEST_PLATEAU_BOUNDARY',[(round(dz,3),round(dc,3),round(rt,3),round(tz,3),[round(float(v),3) for v in z],i) for dz,dc,rt,tz,z,i in candidates[:10]])
''',encoding='utf-8')
